echoParts: The LORD is on my side
verseText: The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
meaning: If God is on our side, we have nothing to fear. How do we know God is on our side? Because he sent his Son to die for us!

recall.question: Who does the writer say is on his side?

meaning.question: Why does having God on his side give the writer courage?
choices: God is greater than anyone he faces
God agrees with everything he does

application.prompt: The world is filled with strong and scary people who bully others to get their way. But in every struggle we face, we can trust that the strongest person is on our side: the LORD God! What has God done for us to show that He's on our side?
